Configuring retries

The client retries idempotent requests that fail with a connection error or a 503 response. Retries use exponential backoff with full jitter.

Options

max_attempts

The total number of attempts, including the first. Defaults to 3.

base_delay

The initial backoff delay. Defaults to 200 ms.

Example

// Retry up to five times.
client := widget.New(widget.WithRetries(5))

Non-idempotent requests, such as POST, are never retried automatically.
